testResults.name: streaming-lake-replay
testResults.result: 6 tests passed for adversarial same-timestamp k-way merge, stable file/row/data fingerprints, lazy reader activation, one-session-at-a-time replay, Parquet row adaptation, and event-bus publication.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed; replay keeps one lookahead event per source and uses no wall clock, random, network, or provider SDK.

decisions: Replay ordering is timestamp, source sequence, fixed event class priority, then deterministic source order.
File readers are activated only for the current session and row fingerprints are streamed without materializing a year of events.
limitations: CLEO completion remains pending until the separately required deployed-dev smoke task T048 is satisfied.
blockers: T048 deployed API/ingest first-query and cached-repeat smoke is not yet recorded.
